findings.message: `sameOnMain` runs `git diff --quiet <branch> HEAD -- .specclaw/changes/<branch name>`. When no folder has the branch's name, the path is missing on both sides. git then exits 0, so `merged()` reports the branch as merged. CI drops the branch and counts it in "left out N merged or archived branches". Before this change, such a branch was pushed and amax flagged it: "not the default branch (main) and no change is named …", which needsReview shows on the Repo sync card. Now a check that could not run reads as "already merged". Fix: count the branch as merged by content only when the folder exists on the branch (`git cat-file -e <b>:<path>`). Otherwise push it as before, or warn that its name matches no change folder. Add a variant to the AC-1 test: a branch whose name matches no folder, or whose folder has a typo.
findings.scenario: origin/specclaw/107-late-fee holds folder 107-late-fees and is not in main's history → `git diff --quiet origin/specclaw/107-late-fee HEAD -- .specclaw/changes/107-late-fee` exits 0 → the job prints "left out 1 merged or archived branches" and pushes nothing. amax never shows the 'no change is named' skip, and the open change never reaches the board.

findings.message: 091 AC-3 adds `sync/sha.ts` as the one commit-sha rule for every specclaw writer. `authorsOf` still writes its own `/@([0-9a-f]{7,40})$/i` to take the sha off a record's `source`, and the bundled copy in plugins/amax/scripts/read-specclaw.mjs repeats it. If `SHA` changes, this copy stops finding the sha, and `authorsOf` falls back to the wrong revision. Build the regex from `SHA` in ./sha (same directory, so the plugin bundle picks it up). Minor because the two copies agree today.

The mock's Repo sync row shows the skips of two different numbers merged into one group: "two changes numbered … (2): CON-074, CON-075". `groupSkips` (ui/skips.ts) groups by the exact reason text, and that text names the number and the folders ("two changes numbered 074: 074-a, 074-b"). So the code always gives one line per number. Show two lines in the mock, or change the grouping to match.
findings.scenario: skips ["CON-074: two changes numbered 074: 074-invoice-export, 074-audit-filters", "CON-075: two changes numbered 075: 075-x, 075-y"] → groupSkips returns two lines, not the mock's single "(2)" line.
